The color of an eggplant is purple.

The competitor's new loyalty program poses a significant threat to our business. By integrating discounts, rewards, and personalization directly into their mobile app, they are creating a high-friction barrier to switching for their existing customers. This strategy directly targets customer retention, which is critical in a competitive market. If successful, the resulting increase in their customer loyalty will likely lead to a measurable decline in our customer base, as users may prioritize the convenience and benefits of their ecosystem over our offerings. We should consider accelerating our own digital engagement initiatives or enhancing our value proposition to counter this move.
